title: 4.6 Everyday Verbs
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Understand and say six everyday actions with I, and add a room or the morning.
grammar_function: I + everyday verb chunk as a learned whole; + in the + room; + in the morning.
prerequisite: 4.5 I routine chunks and in the morning; 4.1 home and rooms; 2.1 school.
speaking_outcome: Say six everyday actions with I.
